item_name: Rothco's Thin Blue Line Paracord Bracelet
item_short_desc: Rothco's Thin Blue Line Paracord Bracelet combines survival readiness with a meaningful display of support for law enforcement. Constructed with durable 7-strand polyester paracord, this 0.75 inch wide bracelet offers essential utility in outdoor or emergency situations. The paracord can be unraveled and used for a variety of survival applications, including securing gear, building a shelter, or crafting makeshift tools. Its quick-release side buckle ensures that you can deploy the paracord in seconds when needed.
description: Rothco's Thin Blue Line Paracord Bracelet combines survival readiness with a meaningful display of support for law enforcement. Constructed with durable 7-strand polyester paracord, this 0.75 inch wide bracelet offers essential utility in outdoor or emergency situations. The paracord can be unraveled and used for a variety of survival applications, including securing gear, building a shelter, or crafting makeshift tools. Its quick-release side buckle ensures that you can deploy the paracord in seconds when needed. Whether you’re hiking, camping, or preparing for emergency situations, this bracelet serves as a practical and versatile tool. Additionally, the Thin Blue Line design represents solidarity with law enforcement, and proceeds from this product benefit families of fallen first responders. Compact, stylish, and functional, the Thin Blue Line Paracord Bracelet is an essential piece of gear for any outdoor adventurer or supporter of law enforcement.
